assumptions: The vector is non-empty and contains at least one element.

findings.title: Loop condition causes out-of-bounds access
findings.explanation: The loop iterates from i = 0 to i <= values.size(), which accesses values[values.size()]. This index is out of bounds because valid indices are 0 to values.size() - 1.
findings.suggested_fix: Change loop condition to i < values.size() to prevent out-of-bounds access.
